newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate down to 11.7 from 11.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate down to 11.7 from 11.8 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate inched down 10 basis points to 11.7 percent on Tuesday, weighed down by low demand for kuna funds.
Daily trade halved to 17.2 million kuna, with 22.8 million surplus left on the supply side.
Fresh loans accounted for meagre 6.7 million kuna, mostly granted at a steady 11 percent rate. Prices for term loans were in a 12-16 percent range.
Old funds were rolled over at rates between 10 and 16 percent.
